spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Comfortable density, strict grid structure, absolute clarity. Government-grade functional UI.

components.inputs: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-[#0A2540] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0A2540]
components.tooltips: bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs py-1 px-2 rounded-sm shadow-md

brand_logo.description: Abstract professional logo for sidebar brand representation

user_avatar.placement: Bottom left of sidebar or top right header

layout.sidebar: Fixed, width 260px, contains Project Switcher (dropdown), 5-stage progress (lock icons for stages 2-5).
layout.main_view: Three-panel split layout, height 100vh (or remaining height minus header).

stage_1_discovery.left_panel: Upload dropzone (dashed border, highly visible). List of files with chunk/entity counts. 'Build Knowledge Base' button. KB Health dashboard (4 metric cards: entities, relationships, tables, roles).
stage_1_discovery.center_panel: RAG Chat. Header with model selector dropdown. Context-sensitive '?' icons (tooltip). Chat history area. Input area with token counter and type-ahead suggestions.
stage_1_discovery.right_panel: SRS Preview. Document-like container with white background and subtle shadow. 8 sections of IEEE SRS. Inline editable text areas. 'Freeze SRS' primary button. 'Export PDF' secondary button.

specific_screens.prompt_library: Grid of versioned cards. Editable fields with clear borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Adhere strictly to light theme only.
Do not implement any animations (e.g., Framer Motion, transition-all). Force 'transition-none' where standard components might use them.
Ensure UI feels government-grade: stark contrast, clear borders, explicit labels.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tooltips, panel containers).
Use a 3-column CSS Grid layout for the main stage 1 view.
